units.description: One row per published transformer (LTDS Table 2: two- and three-winding), filed under the HV winding's voltage class. Impedance is harmonised to percent on 100 MVA and on the unit's own rating; values exactly as reported are kept alongside. profile_id is 'txf-' plus 16 hex of SHA-256 of source_key. SP Energy Networks (SPD, SPM) transformer tables are not held in the lake copy these profiles were built from.

fields.name: profile_id
fields.description: Stable profile identifier (see the table description for its form).

fields.name: profile_rev
fields.description: Revision of this profile. It stays the same while the profile's content is unchanged and goes up by one when any value changes, so profile_id@profile_rev always means one fixed set of values.
fields.source: derived: previous build's revision and content_sha256

fields.name: content_sha256
fields.description: SHA-256 of the profile's values (every field except profile_rev, content_sha256 and last_updated_utc, floats by their exact bits). Used to decide when profile_rev goes up.

fields.name: source_dataset
fields.description: Lake dataset the row was built from.

fields.name: source_key
fields.description: The row's key in its source (an operator ID, or the source row number where the operator publishes no ID).

fields.name: last_updated_utc
fields.description: Profiles last updated: the date these profiles were brought up to.

fields.name: operator
fields.description: Network operator group (ukpn, npg, nged).

fields.name: licence
fields.description: Licence area (EPN, LPN, SPN, NPGN, NPGY, EMID, WMID, SWEST, SWALES).

fields.name: gsp_group
fields.description: Grid supply point or substation group as published.

fields.name: winding_count
fields.description: 2 for a two-winding transformer (LTDS Table 2a), 3 for three-winding (Table 2b).

fields.name: hv_node
fields.description: HV winding connection node as published.

fields.name: hv_substation
fields.description: HV substation name where published (UKPN only).

fields.name: hv_kv
fields.description: HV winding voltage.

fields.name: lv_node
fields.description: LV winding connection node as published.

fields.name: lv_substation
fields.description: LV substation name where published (UKPN only).

fields.name: lv_kv
fields.description: LV winding voltage.

fields.name: tertiary_node
fields.description: Third winding node (three-winding units only).

fields.name: tertiary_kv
fields.description: Third winding voltage (three-winding units only).

fields.name: voltage_class
fields.description: Profiles folder, taken from the HV winding voltage.
fields.source: derived: hv_kv mapped to GB voltage classes

fields.name: status
fields.description: energised, out, planned or unknown. Null where the operator publishes no status (UKPN, NPG).

fields.name: vector_group
fields.description: Winding vector group as published (three-winding: HV/LV1/LV2).

fields.name: rating_mva
fields.description: Nominal or continuous rating (UKPN: winter rating; NPG: transformer rating; NGED: nominal rating).

fields.name: rating_summer_mva
fields.description: Summer rating (UKPN only).

fields.name: rating_emergency_mva
fields.description: Emergency rating (NGED only).

fields.name: rate_a_mva
fields.description: GridSim Rate A (normal, continuous): the published continuous rating (UKPN winter, NPG and NGED season not stated).

fields.name: rate_a_basis
fields.description: What Rate A is: the season or condition the published rating applies to.

fields.name: rate_b_mva
fields.description: [VERIFY] GridSim Rate B (short-term). Not published for these assets, so null; GridSim applies its own documented default.

fields.name: rate_b_basis
fields.description: [VERIFY] What Rate B is (null while Rate B is not published).

fields.name: rate_c_mva
fields.description: GridSim Rate C (emergency): NGED's published emergency rating; null for UKPN and NPG, who publish none.

fields.name: rate_c_basis
fields.description: What Rate C is: the condition or duration of the published emergency rating.

fields.name: r_pct_100mva
fields.description: Positive-sequence resistance in percent on a 100 MVA base (three-winding: HV-LV1 pair).

fields.name: x_pct_100mva
fields.description: Positive-sequence reactance in percent on a 100 MVA base (three-winding: HV-LV1 pair).

fields.name: x0_pct_100mva
fields.description: Zero-sequence reactance in percent on a 100 MVA base (three-winding: HV-LV1 pair).

fields.name: x_lv_tert_pct_100mva
fields.description: Three-winding only: LV1 to LV2 (tertiary) reactance in percent on 100 MVA.

fields.name: x_hv_tert_pct_100mva
fields.description: Three-winding only: HV to LV2 (tertiary) reactance in percent on 100 MVA.

fields.name: r_pct_on_rating
fields.description: Resistance in percent on the transformer's own rating: r_pct_100mva x rating_mva / 100.

fields.name: x_pct_on_rating
fields.description: Reactance (impedance voltage) in percent on the transformer's own rating: x_pct_100mva x rating_mva / 100.

fields.name: x_over_r
fields.description: X/R ratio, set only when R is above zero.

fields.name: tap_min_pct
fields.description: Lowest tap position as a percent change from nominal ratio (UKPN values converted: published value minus 100).

fields.name: tap_max_pct
fields.description: Highest tap position as a percent change from nominal ratio (UKPN values converted: published value minus 100).

fields.name: tap_range_pct
fields.description: Total tap range: tap_max_pct minus tap_min_pct.

fields.name: reported_tap_min
fields.description: Lowest tap exactly as published, in reported_tap_convention.

fields.name: reported_tap_max
fields.description: Highest tap exactly as published, in reported_tap_convention.

fields.name: reported_tap_convention
fields.description: How the operator published tap limits: percent_change (NPG, NGED: for example -12 and +6) or percent_of_nominal_ratio (UKPN: for example 81 and 104).

fields.name: reverse_power_reported
fields.description: Reverse power capability exactly as reported, in reverse_power_unit.

fields.name: reverse_power_unit
fields.description: Unit of reverse_power_reported: % (UKPN, percent of rating), MVA (NPG), or unknown (NGED).

fields.name: earthing_hv
fields.description: Method of earthing as published: the HV winding for UKPN; the single published value for NPG and NGED.

fields.name: earthing_lv
fields.description: LV method of earthing as published (UKPN only).

fields.name: reported_impedance_base
fields.description: Base the operator published impedance on: percent_on_100mva (NPG, documented) or percent_on_100mva_inferred (UKPN and NGED: GDA's normalisers label these percent on own rating and ohmic, but the magnitudes and their fall with rating fit percent on 100 MVA only; see quality_flags and the builder notes).

fields.name: reported_r1
fields.description: Positive-sequence resistance exactly as reported, on reported_impedance_base.

fields.name: reported_x1
fields.description: Positive-sequence reactance exactly as reported, on reported_impedance_base.

fields.name: reported_x0
fields.description: Zero-sequence reactance exactly as reported, on reported_impedance_base.

fields.name: winding_temp_max_degc
fields.description: [VERIFY] Hot-spot winding temperature. No temperature telemetry is held for these units; reserved for a future source.

fields.name: top_oil_temp_max_degc
fields.description: [VERIFY] Top-oil temperature. No temperature telemetry is held for these units; reserved for a future source.

fields.name: named_operator
fields.description: [VERIFY] Operator or owner of the asset, from Transformers/names.csv (named by hand, not published). Null where not named.

fields.name: named_site
fields.description: [VERIFY] Site name, from Transformers/names.csv. Null where not named.

fields.name: named_address
fields.description: [VERIFY] Site address, from Transformers/names.csv. Null where not named.

fields.name: named_by
fields.description: [VERIFY] Who named the asset and when, from Transformers/names.csv.

fields.name: quality_flags
fields.description: Semicolon list of issues found while building the row (for example no_rating, zero_impedance, convention_inferred, hv_below_lv). Empty when none.
